risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~56% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (31 points, ~8% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.392), which favours a weighted combination.
